summary: Chanson International Holding filed a Form 6-K providing notice of an extraordinary general meeting of Class A shareholders and all shareholders scheduled for August 24, 2026, to vote on a special resolution to vary rights attaching to Class A ordinary shares due to increased voting power of Class B ordinary shares. The board approved issuance of 70,000 Class B shares to Danton Global Limited, wholly owned by CEO Gang Li, at $1.17 per share. This is a routine corporate governance filing regarding share issuance and meeting notice, not a special situation.
